## 🎬 Catálogo Interactivo

Explora el catálogo de películas de la Biblioteca Vasconcelos. Usa los filtros para buscar por categoría, título, director o género.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

// Load movie data from JSON
catalog = FileAttachment("data/final_results/catalog.json").json()

// Extract movies array
movies = catalog.movies || []

// Get unique categories for filter
categories = [...new Set(movies.map(m => m.pdf_category || "Sin categoría"))].sort()

// Get unique genres for filter (flatten and dedupe)
genres = [...new Set(movies.flatMap(m => m.genre || []))].sort()

// Stats
enrichedCount = movies.filter(m => m.enriched).length
totalCount = movies.length
```

```{ojs}
  </div>

  </div>
</div>`
```

### 🔍 Filtros

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

// Search input
viewof searchQuery = Inputs.text({
  label: "Buscar",
  placeholder: "Título, director, género, país...",
  value: ""
})

// Category filter
viewof selectedCategory = Inputs.select(
  ["Todas", ...categories],
  {label: "Categoría", value: "Todas"}
)

// Genre filter
viewof selectedGenre = Inputs.select(
  ["Todos", ...genres],
  {label: "Género", value: "Todos"}
)

// Director filter (dynamic based on data)
directors = [...new Set(movies.map(m => m.director).filter(Boolean))].sort()
viewof selectedDirector = Inputs.select(
  ["Todos", ...directors.slice(0, 50)],  // Limit to top 50
  {label: "Director", value: "Todos"}
)

// Reset button
viewof resetFilters = Inputs.button("Restablecer filtros", {value: null})

// Reactive: Reset filters when button clicked
if (resetFilters) {
  searchQuery.value = ""
  selectedCategory.value = "Todas"
  selectedGenre.value = "Todos"
  selectedDirector.value = "Todos"
}

// Filtered movies (reactive)
filteredMovies = {
  let result = movies;

  // Category filter
  if (selectedCategory !== "Todas") {
    result = result.filter(m => m.pdf_category === selectedCategory);
  }

  // Genre filter
  if (selectedGenre !== "Todos") {
    result = result.filter(m => (m.genre || []).includes(selectedGenre));
  }

  // Director filter
  if (selectedDirector !== "Todos") {
    result = result.filter(m => m.director === selectedDirector);
  }

  // Search query filter
  if (searchQuery) {
    const query = searchQuery.toLowerCase();
    result = result.filter(m =>
      (m.search_text || "").includes(query) ||
      (m.title || "").toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
      (m.director || "").toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
      (m.country || "").toLowerCase().includes(query)
    );
  }

  return result;
}
```

### 🎥 Resultados (${filteredMovies.length} películas)

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

// Category badge colors
const categoryColors = {
  "BLU- RAY": "#3b82f6",
  "BLU-RAY": "#3b82f6",
  "CINE": "#f59e0b",
  "PELICULAS INFANTILES": "#10b981",
  "PISO 7": "#8b5cf6",
  "PRESTAMO EN SALA 2026": "#ec4899",
  "DOCUMENTALES": "#6366f1",
  "IDIOMAS": "#14b8a6",
  "ESTUDIO  GHIBLI": "#f97316",
  "PELICULAS CHINAS": "#ef4444",
  "RUSAS": "#dc2626"
};

// Movie grid
movieGrid = {
  if (filteredMovies.length === 0) {
    return html`<div class="no-results">No se encontraron películas con los filtros seleccionados.</div>`;
  }

  const grid = html`<div class="movie-grid"></div>`;

  for (const movie of filteredMovies) {
    const poster = movie.poster || "https://i.imgur.com/Ngnm5v6.png";
    const imdbUrl = movie.imdb_id ? `https://www.imdb.com/title/${movie.imdb_id}` : null;
    const categoryColor = categoryColors[movie.pdf_category] || "#6b7280";

    const card = html`
      <div class="movie-card">
        <div class="movie-poster-container">
          <img class="movie-poster" src="${poster}" alt="${movie.title}" loading="lazy"
               onerror="this.src='https://i.imgur.com/Ngnm5v6.png'">
          ${movie.imdb_rating ? html`<div class="rating-badge">⭐ ${movie.imdb_rating}</div>` : null}
        </div>
        <div class="movie-info">
          <div class="category-badge" style="background: ${categoryColor}20; color: ${categoryColor}; border-color: ${categoryColor}">
            ${movie.category_display || movie.pdf_category}
          </div>
          <h3 class="movie-title" title="${movie.title}">${movie.title}</h3>
          ${movie.matched_title && movie.matched_title !== movie.title ?
            html`<div class="original-title">${movie.matched_title}</div>` : null}
          ${movie.year ? html`<div class="movie-year">📅 ${movie.year}</div>` : null}
          ${movie.director ? html`<div class="movie-director">🎬 ${movie.director}</div>` : null}
          ${movie.genre?.length ? html`<div class="movie-genres">${movie.genre.slice(0, 3).map(g =>
            html`<span class="genre-tag">${g}</span>`
          )}</div>` : null}
          ${movie.country ? html`<div class="movie-country">🌍 ${movie.country}</div>` : null}
          ${movie.plot ? html`<div class="movie-plot">${movie.plot.substring(0, 120)}${movie.plot.length > 120 ? "..." : ""}</div>` : null}
          ${imdbUrl ? html`<a href="${imdbUrl}" target="_blank" class="imdb-link">Ver en IMDb →</a>` : null}
        </div>
      </div>
    `;
    grid.appendChild(card);
  }

  return grid;
}

movieGrid
```
